language.name: English
title.subtitle: Tech company simulation — from your bedroom to your own offices
title.legacy: Your old roguelike profile (profile.json) is kept as it is; its ingots and Legacy do not exist in this simulation.
new.title: New campaign
new.intro: A new campaign never replaces another one: each has its own saves.
new.profileText.developer: Code 62, design 30, testing 40, support 35. Fast on integrations and tools.
new.profileText.designer: Design 64, code 38, testing 34, support 40. Shines on showcase websites and redesigns.
new.profileText.generalist: Everything around 45. Nothing blocks you, nothing is excellent.
new.look: Your appearance (no effect on the game)
new.seed: Seed (optional, to replay exactly the same game)
new.tutorial: Tutorial: a few instructions to get started (skip at any time)
new.abandon.title: Discard what you typed?
new.abandon.text: The information you entered will be lost.
error.company.short: The name must be at least two characters long.
error.company.long: The name must not exceed {0} characters.
load.title: Load a game
load.deleteText: “{0}” and its {1} save(s) will disappear from the list.
load.deleteWhere: The files are moved to {0}: they can still be recovered by hand.
settings.title: Settings
settings.largeText: Larger text (easier to read, slightly less crisp)
settings.fastNights: Nights and weekends with nobody at the office run ×8 faster
settings.pauseTerminal: The company waits while you type at the terminal
settings.pauseTerminalNote: What a word yields never depends on elapsed time: this setting only changes what happens while you type.
settings.simplifiedNote: Simplified typing: the word types itself and Enter confirms it. Each word yields like slow typing (×0.85): less than fast typing, enough to run the campaign.
settings.logsNote: If an error occurs, a log is written to {0}, and the current game is kept aside (“Emergency save”).
pause.title: Pause
pause.note: Leaving the menu or the game automatically writes an exit save. Nothing is ever erased.
toolbar.workNone: Nothing to do at the terminal: create a project or queue a component.
top.speed: Speed {0} ({1:0} game minutes per second) — key {0}
